summary: Conditional two-stage free: frees the inner buffer stored at this+0x0 when it is non-null, then frees the container node itself only when argument a2 has bit 0 set, and returns the container pointer. The caller set (render node list destructor, complex linked-list destructor, profile scanner, UI render pass) is consistent with a shared container teardown helper.

local_names.a2: flags byte; bit 0 selects whether the container node itself is freed

operations.description: Check that the inner buffer pointer at this+0x0 is non-null before attempting to free it.
Free the inner buffer pointed to by this+0x0 via FreeWrapper_7bcf when it is non-null.
Test bit 0 of argument a2; the container node is freed only when the bit is set.
Free the container node this via FreeWrapper_7bcf when a2 bit 0 is set.
Return this (the container pointer) unchanged to the caller.

unresolved: Whether the inner buffer and container node were allocated as one block is not evidenced; only that both are handed to the shared free wrapper.
The exact container type is unknown; only the single inner pointer field at this+0x0 is evidenced.
